title: Sugar-free squash with aspartame but no phenylalanine warning

blocks.text: Ingredients: Water, Citric acid, Orange juice from concentrate (5%), ASPARTAME (E951), Natural orange flavouring, Preservative (potassium sorbate)
Nutrition Information (per 100 ml): Energy 4 kcal, Fat 0.0 g, Carbohydrate 0.9 g of which sugars 0.9 g, Fibre 0.0 g, Protein 0.0 g, Salt 0.01 g
Made in the UK for Brighton Beverages Ltd, 14 Harbour View, Brighton, BN1 2AA, United Kingdom
Store in a cool place out of direct sunlight. Refrigerate after opening.

notes: Aspartame is capitalised and listed with its E number, satisfying the allergen emphasis style used elsewhere in this rule pack, but aspartame is not an allergen, it is a sweetener that triggers a separate mandatory warning statement about phenylalanine which does not appear anywhere on the label. Isolated single violation of RULE-UK-FOOD-012.
